feature.name: Model_Federation
feature.description: Represents the overall approach of Model Federation for integrating heterogeneous models and managing their evolution.

feature.name: Structural
feature.description: Covers the artefacts, links, and structural aspects of Model Federation, including models, virtual models, concepts, and technological infrastructure.

feature.name: Artifacts
feature.description: Groups the primary modelling artefacts involved in a federation.

feature.name: Model
feature.description: Represents an individual model participating in the federation, such as UML, BPMN, Excel, or SysML models. Trace: [Article_11 §34]

feature.name: VirtualModel
feature.description: A container that holds FlexoConcept instances and can be serialized back to the information space. Trace: [Article_11 §34]

feature.name: FlexoConcept
feature.description: An n‑ary relationship between modelling elements that defines a federated concept. Trace: [Article_13 §35]

feature.name: ConceptRole
feature.description: Assigns a name to a modelling element reference within a FlexoConcept. Trace: [Article_13 §35]

feature.name: Links
feature.description: Defines the reified connections between artefacts in the federation.

feature.name: FlexoLink
feature.description: A link that reifies a dependency between two modelling elements. Trace: [Article_11 §44]

feature.name: SecurityRuleLink
feature.description: A link that carries an attached security rule for evaluation upon changes. Trace: [Article_11 §44]

feature.name: GraphStructure
feature.description: Describes the graph‑based representation of model dependencies.

feature.name: DependencyGraph
feature.description: A directed graph capturing dependencies among models for ordering change propagation. Trace: [Article_11 §33]

feature.name: MultiModelGraph
feature.description: The pseudo‑graph G(V,E) where vertices are models and edges represent data flow between output and input attributes. Trace: [Article_11 §33]

feature.name: Formalism
feature.description: Specifies the modelling languages and adapters used to access models.

feature.name: DSML
feature.description: Domain‑specific modelling languages such as UML, BPMN, SysML, etc., used to create the participating models. Trace: [Article_11 §46]

feature.name: TechnologyAdapter
feature.description: Software component that provides read/write access to a specific technology or file format. Trace: [Article_13 §42]

feature.name: Domain
feature.description: Addresses domain‑specific concerns, notably security.

feature.name: SecurityDomain
feature.description: Encapsulates security‑related concepts, requirements and annotations used in the federation. Trace: [Article_11 §45]

feature.name: TechnologicalContext
feature.description: Infrastructure components that support storage, versioning and access to models.

feature.name: Repository
feature.description: A version‑controlled storage that holds all artefacts of the multi‑model. Trace: [Article_11 §38]

feature.name: Sandbox
feature.description: Local copy of the repository allowing modelers to work concurrently without interfering with others. Trace: [Article_11 §25]

feature.name: ModelSlot
feature.description: A symbolic link to a resource in the information space, exposing its structural and behavioural contents. Trace: [Article_13 §48]

feature.name: TypeAwareModelSlot
feature.description: A ModelSlot that enforces conformance to a specific metamodel. Trace: [Article_13 §48]

feature.name: Operational
feature.description: Encompasses the processes, operations and triggers that manipulate federated models, focusing on querying, synchronisation, validation and management.

feature.name: Querying
feature.description: Mechanisms to retrieve information about model dependencies and attributes.

feature.name: DependencyQuery
feature.description: Provides queries over the dependency graph to determine propagation order or impact analysis. Trace: [Article_11 §41]

feature.name: Synchronisation
feature.description: Handles the propagation of changes across models in the federation.

feature.name: ChangePropagation
feature.description: Strategies for propagating model edits through the dependency graph.

feature.name: DepthFirstSearchPropagation
feature.description: Executes a depth‑first search on the dependency graph, propagating changes from leaves upward. Trace: [Article_11 §33]

feature.name: RuleBasedPropagation
feature.description: Uses security rules attached to links to decide how and when to propagate changes. Trace: [Article_11 §44]

feature.name: ExpertInputPropagation
feature.description: Invokes expert input to resolve cycles or ambiguous ordering in the dependency graph. Trace: [Article_11 §33]

feature.name: Validation
feature.description: Ensures that the federated models remain consistent and respect defined constraints.

feature.name: ConsistencyCheck
feature.description: Checks different aspects of multi‑model consistency.

feature.name: AttributeConsistency
feature.description: All attributes have been updated by their owner model since the last input change. Trace: [Article_11 §32]

feature.name: ConstraintConsistency
feature.description: Current attribute values do not violate any model‑specific constraints. Trace: [Article_11 §32]

feature.name: AttributeModelConsistency
feature.description: Model edit timestamps precede the timestamps of their output attributes. Trace: [Article_11 §32]

feature.name: SecurityValidation
feature.description: Evaluates attached security rules after a change to detect violations. Trace: [Article_11 §44]

feature.name: Management
feature.description: Operational support for versioning, notifications and execution orchestration.

feature.name: VersionManagement
feature.description: Provides rollback, version control and reconstruction of any federation state. Trace: [Article_11 §38]

feature.name: NotificationManagement
feature.description: Sends notifications to models when relevant events (e.g., attribute change, rule violation) occur. Trace: [Article_11 §29]

feature.name: ExecutionManagement
feature.description: Determines an execution order based on dependencies and orchestrates model execution to reach a consistent state. Trace: [Article_11 §41]

feature.name: Intentional
feature.description: Addresses the goals and objectives of Model Federation such as traceability, consistency assurance, transformation management, composition and security.

feature.name: Objectives
feature.description: High‑level aims pursued by the federation.

feature.name: ConsistencyAssurance
feature.description: Ensures that the multi‑model satisfies defined consistency properties.

feature.name: NAOMIConsistency
feature.description: Defines a NAOMI‑consistent multi‑model as having attribute, constraint and attribute‑model consistency. Trace: [Article_11 §36]

feature.name: SecurityAssurance
feature.description: Guarantees that security requirements (privacy, integrity, authentication, authorization) are respected throughout model evolution. Trace: [Article_11 §45]

feature.name: Composition
feature.description: Mechanisms to compose and federate heterogeneous models.

feature.name: ModelComposition
feature.description: Creates a VirtualModel that aggregates FlexoConcepts to represent the federation of individual models. Trace: [Article_11 §33]

feature.name: Traceability
feature.description: Facilities to track changes and their impact across the federation.

feature.name: ChangeTraceability
feature.description: Records which models and attributes were affected by a change and propagates this information to dependent models. Trace: [Article_11 §29]

feature.name: TransformationManagement
feature.description: Handles data transformations during inter‑model exchanges.

feature.name: DataTransformation
feature.description: Allows transformation of attribute data when moving between models of different DSMLs. Trace: [Article_11 §11]

feature.name: ConceptualElicitation
feature.description: Processes to make implicit dependencies explicit and to attach semantics.

feature.name: DependencyReification
feature.description: Reifies inter‑model dependencies as explicit links (FlexoLink) within the federation. Trace: [Article_11 §44]
